_: Schema of the ICM component library. SINGLE SOURCE OF TRUTH: build.py checks that every component here has a custom element in components/, and every artifact build validates its data against this file, so the schema and the code cannot drift. The agent that writes content reads this file and the skill's SKILL.md, nothing else. Keys are English; every value the user sees is in the owner's language.

where.cover: first screen of a reel: the topic's name and its aggregate. Takes `title`, `subtitle`, `media`, `video`, `tone`, and everything a story takes.
where.story: a screen inside a reel, listed left to right.
where.front: seen at a glance, over the photo. Holds up to three components, or it is not read while listing.
where.details: opens with the Detalji action and replaces the front state. Everything that is read goes here.

surfaces.on-photo: text over an image; fixed light colors plus a measured scrim
surfaces.on-paper: text on the Claude paper background; theme colors, light and dark

hook.about: One sentence that makes him stop. The tension is real: a deadline, an open question, a number that deviates. It does NOT end on a shortfall; the end of the sentence carries the payoff or the next move.
hook.when: Always. Without it a story has no reason to exist.

variants.loud: large and accented; when the number IS the point
variants.quiet: smaller and calm; when the number follows the story

metric.when: When one number carries the story. A metric without `label` fails the check.

tags.when: When state changes what you do: "not sent", "wait", "deadline passed". Not for decoration.

deadline.about: The page counts the days from today itself and turns warm at three days. A malformed date renders nothing rather than "NaN days".
deadline.when: When a date exists after which the decision no longer holds.

delta.when: When the number means nothing without a comparison: off the average, off the plan, off last time.

gauge.when: When a plan, threshold or estimate exists to measure against. Without `target` it is just a bar and rarely worth it.

body.about: Two to four sentences, concrete, with numbers.
body.when: When the story needs prose. A story must have `body` or `facts`.

facts.about: A value longer than 34 characters moves to its own full-width block by itself, so nobody has to think about length.
facts.when: When the answer is a set of facts that get compared: price, area, status, date checked.

quote.when: When the exact wording carries the decision: an article of law, a rule from a skill, a sentence from the handbook. Verbatim, never paraphrased.

variants.checks: state per item, for what gets worked off

list.when: When the answer is a list and not a number.

variants.line: flow through time, when the shape matters
variants.bars: separate periods, when single values get compared

series.when: When the shape over time says what the latest number does not.

next.when: When a clear first step exists. Never invented to give the card an ending.

links.when: When it leads out: a listing, a message, a document, ANOTHER ARTIFACT.

media.about: A portrait image goes full bleed, a wide one into a frame with a blurred copy behind it; the page picks by the aspect ratio measured at build time.
media.when: When the story has a real picture of its own. Without one it falls back to the reel cover, and that is fine.

source.when: Always. A card without a source does not enter the feed.

props.params: values the action's input template needs

actions.about: Picked from actions.json, never invented: the mcp manifest is declared at publish time, so a call outside it fails.
actions.when: When the card can DO something, not only say something.

props.question: asked in the owner's language, second person

choice.when: When the feed needs to ask him something: one or more of the offered answers. The answer lands in db under answers/<day>/<key>.

props.question: asked in the owner's language, second person

slider.when: When the feed needs to ask him something: a number in a range. The answer lands in db under answers/<day>/<key>.

props.question: asked in the owner's language, second person

input.when: When the feed needs to ask him something: one short line of text. The answer lands in db under answers/<day>/<key>.

props.question: asked in the owner's language, second person

confirm.when: When the feed needs to ask him something: yes or no. The answer lands in db under answers/<day>/<key>.

rules: A slot is taken because that kind of data exists, not to make the card look richer.
At most three components beside the hook in the front state; the feed is listed, not read.
Every number and every claim must exist in the base, at the path in `source`.
Repetition is hoisted into `reel.defaults`, not written per story.
If the rule for picking or ordering is not written down in the base, say so on the card instead of deriving a score.
An action comes from actions.json and a form writes to db; neither is invented per card.
